name: templatesources

sources.description: Includes information regarding all sources that have been added to SideWaffle.

Enabled.description: Indicates whether the source template(s) should be added to Visual Studio.

Location.description: The location of the source to be added. This can be on a git repository or local file share.

Branch.description: The branch of the source repository containing the template.

updateInterval.description: Used by SideWaffle to determine how often Visual Studio will download and install the templates from its source.

schema.title: JSON schema for SideWaffle template sources

description:
Subject: SideWaffle Template Source Configuration – Current Settings  

Dear Team,  

We have two template sources configured for SideWaffle. The first source, **CommunityTemplates**, is active and will contribute its templates to Visual Studio. It points to the Git repository at `https://github.com/CommunityTemplates/SideWaffle-Templates.git` and uses the **main** branch. The second source, **LocalShare**, is currently disabled; its location is a local share at `file:///C:/Templates/SideWaffle`, and it references the **master** branch when enabled.  

Please note that the update interval for fetching and installing templates from these sources is set to **OnceADay**. Let us know if any adjustments are required.
